system.description:
Your companion acts during your turn. You are in permanent communication with it. It can:

  • Move (it cannot fly but can move in Zero G).

  • Attack in melee (using the same benefits you have as well as your Proficiency).

  • Interact with its environment.

  • Activate one of your @UUID[Compendium.daggerheart-scifi-content.character-options.cmQ1erqGqemNvB7U]{Field Devices} if in Melee range of it.

  • Talk.

Your companion has 3 Stress markers starts with an Evasion of 10. Everytime your companion would take any amount of damage, it marks a Stress. When it marks its last Stress, it deactivates and remains unavailable until the start of your next long rest. When you choose a downtime move that clears a Stress on yourself, your companion clears an equal number of Stress.

Attack and damage.

Your companion starts with a d6 damage dice and Melee range. Make a Spellcast roll to attack.

Training.

When your character levels up, choose one of these options for you companion:

  • [0/3] Resilient: your companion gains an additional Stress slot.

  • [0/1] Armored: when your companion takes damage, you can mark one of your Armor Slots instead of a Stress.

  • [0/3] Hydraulics: increase the damage dice by one step (d6 to d8, d8 to d10, etc.)

  • [0/1] Not My Master: when you mark your last HP, your companion rushes to save you. It takes 1d6 Stress point instead of you taking a HP.

  • [0/3] Aware: your companion gains +1 to its Evasion.
